changes.summary: Recognize the exact VS Code Insiders OAuth redirect alongside stable VS Code; retain unknown-host rejection.
Resolve shared commerce policy from authenticated registered callback channels without per-account canary bindings.
Add estimate-based background work admission while preserving exact-ID recovery and hard charge caps.
Add durable background work launch and read-only recovery tools with matching text and structured progress.
Preserve saved credit work results in identical text and structured host responses
Display complete action-specific review terms and respect per-action approval availability
Bind explicit prepaid budgets to action review and confirmation and display durable credit usage
Hide approval controls when an action review has no confirmation capability.
Add exact-version outbound review tools and rich durable job status with read-only recovery.
Add shared reviewed business selection tools and an MCP App with explicit revision-bound confirmation.
Add read-only setup and budget-preview tools with shared Apps and text fallbacks
Document scoped individual Copilot paid-work eligibility and deployment budget requirements
Correct the VS Code checkout canary after verifying native Windows link consent and document the individual Copilot channel review
Ship a synthetic external-checkout host canary with expiring links, explicit approval and purchase-status checks
Use text and structured report results on affected VS Code builds while their upstream webview startup race remains unresolved
Allow verified patched hosts through the version fallback with optional Apps configuration
Distribute a verified VS Code webview startup-race source patch and actual-method regression checker, with explicit upstream delivery requirements
Ship an authenticated two-account staging canary for read isolation, credential rejection and session reconnect with private credentials and aggregate-only results
Authorize session deletion, recover explicit client initialization after expiry, and preserve typed HTTP failures without replaying tools
Accept the standard protocol-header compatibility fallback used by VS Code Copilot and record native report rendering evidence
Record verified Claude web rendering, refresh, pagination and narrow-viewport host canary evidence
Ship a preflight-validated synthetic host canary and record Claude Code and Codex terminal interoperability evidence
Negotiate MCP Apps with persisted capabilities, guarded offline UI resources and reusable SDK-backed billing views
Preserve remote UI metadata in the client and expose immutable PostgreSQL migration entries

Extend McpClientOptions, McpRemoteTool, createSessionRegistry, McpSessionStore, McpServerConfig, McpTool and McpToolResult with optional Apps capability and metadata fields; existing text-only callers remain supported
Add account-bound billing status, paginated receipts, bounded usage and reviewed billing-management links
Build and test before publishing so checkout exports are present in the distributed artifact
Add commerce-classified account-bound checkout handoff and purchase status tools
Add explicit credit-budget envelopes for durable prepaid MCP work
Add reviewed host commerce eligibility, execution guards, and reusable credit status tools
